items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I went out for four years, 1972 to ’76 with Sammy... I couldn’t wait to get on the stand at night... half of the show was just him and piano.

ctx.x: So it was important to go home for you.
Yeah. I mean I went out for four years, 1972 to ’76 with Sammy, mainly because it was so much fun. It was probably the most fun job I’ve ever had in my life.
